title: Fall Romance Book Clipart Book Lover PNG
author: CozyNest Studio
description:
🍂 Celebrate cozy reading season with this Fall Romance Book Clipart collection featuring 20 autumn bookish illustrations created for romance readers and book lovers. The set combines fall reading essentials, romance books, cozy drinks, TBR moments, reading plans, bookish accessories, seasonal decor, and playful reader-themed details.
From romance book stacks and autumn reading baskets to pumpkin spice drinks, cozy reading chairs, Kindle designs, book hauls, candles, bookmarks, and fall TBR inspiration, this collection is perfect for creating warm seasonal projects for readers who love romance, spicy books, and cozy autumn reading days.
📚  Perfect for:
– Book lover stickers
– Romance reader gifts
– Fall bookish designs
– Autumn reading stickers
– Romance book merchandise
– Book club projects
– Reading journal decorations
– TBR tracker designs
– Kindle reader accessories
– Bookish planner stickers
– Scrapbooking
– Journaling
– Bookmarks
– Greeting cards
– Tote bags
– Mugs and tumblers
– T-shirts and sweatshirts
– Seasonal stationery
– Sublimation projects
– Print on Demand
📚 What’s included:
– 20 PNG files with transparent backgrounds
– 20 SVG files
– 3000 x 3000 px
🍁 Included illustrations:
Reader in Hibernation jar, autumn romance book, pumpkin spice drink with book, cozy romance book stack with scarf, pumpkin candle on romance books, sweet chapter box, autumn book haul tote, Fall Reading Plans pumpkin planner, Love at First Chapter envelope, sweater with romance books, Annotate & Adore stationery cup, cozy reading chair with book, Spicy Chapter Treat box, fall TBR book stack, Book Boyfriend Mode e-reader, Read Rest Repeat candle, Pumpkin Spice & Paperbacks drink, bookish comfort basket, Currently Reading Romance desk calendar, Cozy Chapter Club design
🧡 This autumn romance clipart bundle is ideal for cozy bookish merchandise, romance reader gifts, fall reading challenges, book club projects, seasonal planner pages, Kindle accessories, journaling, stickers, apparel, mugs, tote bags, and other reader-focused designs. Use each illustration individually or combine several elements to create cozy autumn reading scenes filled with romance books, pumpkin spice, fall TBRs, and book lover favorites.
